flags.purpose: Retrieves services by internal service name to check status and startup configuration.
flags.security_use_case: Verify critical security services like Defender and Event Log are running and set to Automatic.
flags.threat_detected: Disabled antivirus or stopped event logging indicating tampering with security controls.
flags.risk_if_misused: Querying is read-only, but acting on results (stop/start) can affect system stability.
flags.safe_followup: If needed, use Start-Service and Set-Service -StartupType Automatic after confirming legitimacy.

flags.purpose: Retrieves services by human-readable display name with wildcard support.
flags.security_use_case: Locate all Defender-related services without knowing internal names.
flags.threat_detected: Missing or altered Defender services suggesting tampering or replacement by malware.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. May return multiple results requiring filtering.
flags.safe_followup: Check dependencies and verify service binary path via Win32_Service PathName.

flags.example_command: Get-Service -Name W32Time | Select-Object -ExpandProperty DependentServices | Select-Object Name,Status,StartType
flags.purpose: Lists services that depend on the specified service.
flags.security_use_case: Understand impact radius before modifying a critical service.
flags.threat_detected: Security services indirectly affected by a compromised or stopped parent service.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Useful for safe remediation planning.
flags.safe_followup: Document dependencies before changes; restart in correct order if needed.

flags.example_command: Get-Service -Name Dhcp | Select-Object -ExpandProperty RequiredServices | Select-Object Name,Status
flags.purpose: Lists services required by the specified service to function.
flags.security_use_case: Ensure dependencies for network/security services are operational.
flags.threat_detected: Stopped dependencies preventing proper startup of security-related services.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Dependency chains may be long.
flags.safe_followup: Start required services first; verify with dependency queries.

flags.purpose: Includes services matching a pattern to find related services quickly.
flags.security_use_case: Locate all event-related services targeted during attacks to disable logging.
flags.threat_detected: Event services stopped to hide attacker activity.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Pattern matching is broad.
flags.safe_followup: Cross-check with event logs to ensure logging is active.

flags.purpose: Excludes common Windows services to focus on third-party or unfamiliar services.
flags.security_use_case: Surface non-system services that may be malicious or unwanted.
flags.threat_detected: Unknown services persisting on the system indicating malware or PUPs.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. May hide legitimate third-party tools.
flags.safe_followup: Investigate unfamiliar services, verify binary path and signature.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Highlights disabled security-critical services often targeted by attackers.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Detect post-compromise attempts to weaken host defenses.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Finds running services executing from non-system paths where malware commonly resides.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Detect rogue services from ProgramData, Temp, or user directories.

powerful_combinations.command: Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Status -eq 'Running' -and $_.DisplayName -notmatch 'Microsoft|Windows'} | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ Name=$_.Name; DisplayName=$_.DisplayName; Path=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter "Name='$($_.Name)'").PathName } }
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Surfaces active third-party services with their executable paths for review.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Audit non-Microsoft services for risk, misconfiguration, or compromise.
